subject: Implement hybrid conversation compaction
description:
Build `capo/memory/compaction.py` per §5.7: when current session's history tokens exceed `compaction.threshold_tokens` (default 100,000), identify oldest 50% of messages, summarize via `config.models.router`, **retain all messages referencing an active delegation handle (`cc-<id>` or `codex-<id>`) verbatim** regardless of age, persist compacted history, log a `capo.memory.compact` Logfire span.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Token counter for the active session uses the same model family as `config.models.default`.
- [ ] At threshold: oldest 50% messages identified by `message_index`.
- [ ] Cheap model (`config.models.router`) summarizes them into a single system message.
- [ ] Active delegation handles preserved verbatim. **Active** = any delegation in `running` or `pending_approval` state at compaction time (per §5.7 definition).
- [ ] Compacted history persisted; `sessions.compacted_to_message_index` updated.
- [ ] `capo.memory.compact` span emitted with `thread_id`, `messages_summarized`, `tokens_before`, `tokens_after` per §6.5.
- [ ] When `compaction.enabled = false` (per §11.2), compaction is a no-op.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Every old message references an active delegation: compaction is a no-op (nothing summarizable).
- [ ] Token counting fails: log warning, skip compaction this turn.

_Performance:_
- [ ] Compaction step < 5s with cheap model on a 110K-token history (per §10.3).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: synthetic 110K-token history triggers compaction; messages referencing active handles preserved verbatim
• Integration: compacted-to marker prevents re-compaction of the same range
• Performance: < 5s per §10.3

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.7, 6.5, 9.5, 10.3, 11.2
